Sure! Here are a few common phrases that might come across as ironic or unexpected:

1. "Great, just what I needed."
2. "That sounds perfect for me."
3. "Thanks for bringing this up, it couldn't have happened at a better time."
4. "I love it when things go according to plan."

These are often said when the opposite is true, adding an element of humor or sarcasm that can be lost on listeners who don’t recognize the context.
